acceptanceCriteria: The witness/runner summary marks a serial-cascade skip with a distinct reason naming the failing earlier test, covered by a synthetic report fixture
A plain skip (test.skip) keeps its existing reason
body: GitHub #1123 optional ask, not delivered by PR #1125. When a test in a serial Playwright suite fails, later tests report skipped; a targeted witness run then reports the target as a plain skip. Expected: the runner-facing summary distinguishes a serial-cascade skip and names the failing earlier test. Actual: plain skip.
title: Runner summary: report skipped-because-earlier-serial-test-failed separately from a plain skip (#1123 optional ask)
